methodology: Read only the Data Bank publications selected by its CLI, with --lineage-only. Exact duplicate records are removed within the listed query columns; counts are not cross-provider reconciled or assertions of statistical correctness. Data readiness still requires keys, units, identities and source-cell checks.

probes.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT(DISTINCT period_end) AS periods, MIN(period_end) AS first_period, MAX(period_end) AS last_period, COUNT(DISTINCT sub_category) AS categories FROM (SELECT DISTINCT period_end, parent_category, sub_category, row_kind, n_schemes, n_folios, funds_mobilized_inr_cr, repurchase_redemption_inr_cr, net_flow_inr_cr, net_aum_inr_cr, avg_aum_inr_cr FROM {table}) ORDER BY first_period

SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT(DISTINCT state) AS states, COUNT(DISTINCT category) AS categories, MIN(date) AS first_period, MAX(date) AS last_period FROM (SELECT DISTINCT state, date, category, aum_inr_cr FROM {table}) ORDER BY first_period

SELECT family, COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT(DISTINCT series) AS series, MIN(period_month) AS first_period, MAX(period_month) AS last_period FROM (SELECT DISTINCT family, entity, series, measure, unit, period_month, value FROM {table}) GROUP BY family ORDER BY family
SELECT iso3, COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT(DISTINCT portid) AS ports, MIN(date) AS first_period, MAX(date) AS last_period FROM (SELECT DISTINCT iso3, portid, date FROM {table}) GROUP BY iso3 ORDER BY iso3

SELECT report_id, report_name, COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT(DISTINCT prompt_answer) AS prompt_answers FROM (SELECT DISTINCT report_id, report_name, prompt_answer, dataprovider_id, row_no, record_json FROM {table}) GROUP BY report_id, report_name ORDER BY report_id, report_name
